plan: The target gesture is Kapittha hasta (asamyuta hasta). In this gesture, the hand is held upright with the forearm vertical and palm facing front/three-quarters. The middle, ring, and little fingers are curled tightly into the palm as in Shikhara/Mushti (MCP flexed ~70-90, PIP flexed ~90-100, DIP flexed ~40-60). The thumb is held upright/abducted, and the index finger curls over (MCP flexed ~40-60, PIP flexed ~80-100, DIP flexed) so that the index fingertip presses onto the tip of the thumb.
